**Current**
- He is Indiana's backup center behind Ivica Zubac and comes off the bench. (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/EGdhmUgPAWY?t=1482), [10-01](https://youtu.be/EGdhmUgPAWY?t=1308), [09-14](https://youtu.be/t4n9MAP2_14?t=1534), [07-20](https://youtu.be/-KS_AZjZnw4?t=1526))
- The center depth behind him is weak (Larry Nance Jr. or Kobe Brown). (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/EGdhmUgPAWY?t=1884))
- Coach Rick Carlisle keeps center minutes low and runs backups through the rotation. How he splits minutes between Zubac and Huff is an open question. (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/EGdhmUgPAWY?t=170), [08-10](https://youtu.be/sfCe7fS9daM?t=1146), [08-10](https://youtu.be/sfCe7fS9daM?t=1287), [09-14](https://youtu.be/t4n9MAP2_14?t=1534))
- Not draftable in standard leagues and not a sleeper. His Yahoo ADP of 102 is too high. (verdict, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/EGdhmUgPAWY?t=1588))
- The stash on this team. If Zubac misses time, Huff would have to start. (verdict, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/EGdhmUgPAWY?t=1873))
- Indiana plays 3, 4 and 3 games in our fantasy playoff weeks, which the expert calls not ideal. The team has 15 back-to-backs. (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/EGdhmUgPAWY?t=2034))
- Expected to play about 10 minutes behind Zubac. He could take all the backup center minutes if he plays well. (verdict, 2026-08-10; [08-10](https://youtu.be/sfCe7fS9daM?t=1219))
- His 1.9 blocks per game from last season are not expected to hold. (verdict, 2026-07-07; [07-07](https://youtu.be/ME-r173X5b0?t=1921))

**Durable**
- Weak in points, rebounds, assists and steals. Steals are a league-level weakness, and his rebounding is low for a center. (fact, 2026-10-04; [10-01](https://youtu.be/EGdhmUgPAWY?t=1527), stats)
- A one category blocks player. Blocks are his only clearly strong category. (verdict, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/EGdhmUgPAWY?t=1527), stats)

**Tags**
- Current: `handcuff` (Would start if Ivica Zubac misses time; depth behind him is weak), `waiver watch` (Not draftable in standard leagues; add if Zubac is out or his minutes grow), `bust candidate` (Yahoo ADP 102 is too high), `bad playoff schedule` (IND plays 3-4-3 games in weeks 19 to 21)
- Durable: none

**Note.** Huff is a backup center who adds blocks and little else. His 2026-27 projection is 1.4 blocks and 3.0 rebounds per game, and he is weak in steals. Yahoo values him at 0 USD (rank 189) and he went for 1 USD in our league last season, so he should not be drafted in a 144-player auction. Watch early how Carlisle splits minutes between Zubac and Huff, and pick him up if Zubac misses time, since he would then start.
